description.en: Evolves a character's avatar with the standard "J_07" jingle presentation and a caller-specified message — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunEvolutionAvatarEx (with actual evolution enabled).
Optional; whether to lock the avatar after evolving (defaults to true).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Evolve an avatar with a specific message, as RunEvolutionAvatar does internally
RunEvolutionAvatarUseMsg("para_cp0008", "ck0033", "sysmes-Avatar-00002", true);
